title: Robust Input Library
description: Build `namespace Input` in `input.h` / `input.cpp`. The three files are in the explorer: declarations go in the header, the code in `input.cpp`, and `main.cpp` tries every function.
requirements: `int getInt(std::string_view prompt, int min, int max)` *(you'll learn overloading next milestone — for now name it `getIntInRange`)*
`char getChar(std::string_view prompt, std::string_view allowed)` — e.g. allowed `"yn"`
A `main.cpp` test program that tries every function
Test with: letters, empty input, `12abc`, huge numbers, and end of input (Ctrl+D in Xenon's terminal)
